title: Antiguo Casino de Ponce

buildingCutout.basis: Only the present former-casino cadastral outline, with the surveyed chamfer.

terrainReference.basis: Unchanged USGS one-metre elevation at the north entrance sidewalk on Calle Luna.

identities.name: Antiguo Casino de Ponce
identities.address: Calle Marina at Calle Luna, Cuarto, Ponce, Puerto Rico

mapIdentity.scope: Native cadastral outline and USDA 30 cm orthophoto set dimensions and roof footprint. The photographed corner chamfer is restored to the simplified mapped outline.

note: The documented five north bays, seven west bays, single curved chamber, ornamented balusters and tiled mansard follow the primary National Register description and directly cleared 1984 facade view.
